docs.purpose: Gives an admin a button to immediately re-run the back half of the data pipeline — cost estimates, forecasts, snapshots — after changing a pricing setting, instead of waiting for the next scheduled run.
docs.data_story: It touches no table at all. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 3 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/admin-controls/api/useTriggerPipeline.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `COMMAND`. It declares the JOB it triggers (`job_ref`), its concurrency posture and the audit row it must write. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: The route itself performs no DB reads or writes — it fire-and-forget spawns `node scripts/run-chain.js permits` as a detached child process and returns the static step list immediately; pipeline_runs tracking and all DB work happen inside that script. Every failure mode (spawn error :64-66, non-zero exit :68-77, missing script :85-91) returns 200.
